summary: D4a-1: Academic Paper Registry foundation + local-source backfill. New automation/literature/paper_registry.yaml holds 47 canonical papers owning 48 citation keys, populated READ-ONLY from local, already-committed sources only: the thesis repository's references.bib (bibliographic authority), the D1--D12 literature-framing subsection of appendices/internal_defense_experiment_ledger.md (all 36 anchor-table citations = 34 unique papers across D1-D12, with kannan2018adversarial shared by D4+D9 and narasimhan2013partialauc shared by D6+D8), and chapter .tex citation context. NO web access, API, Crossref/Semantic-Scholar lookup, or download occurred; every record carries verification_status local_bib_only and registry_scope.external_metadata_verification=pending (D4a-2 boundary). Seed coverage: all 12 D1-D12 lines (3 anchors each, exactly as the appendix maps them), robust-optimization/PGD (madry2018towards, per the framing introduction), dataset framework (yang2022sensefi/SenseFi -- the only local UT-HAR coverage; no separate UT-HAR-origin citation exists locally, recorded as gap_ut_har_source_publication), FGSM/adversarial-training foundations (goodfellow2015explaining, kurakin2017adversarial, wong2020fast), named defense methods TRADES (zhang2019trades), GAIRAT (zhang2021gairat + liu2021probabilisticmargins + hitaj2021evaluatinggairat), SAT (pan2024sat + ye2025scaling + rasheed2023rsda; BASAT recorded ONLY as an internal label, never a paper), and locally cited candidate-direction anchors: NP/threshold control (tong2013pluginnp, tong2018np, cotter2019constrained), partial AUC (narasimhan2013partialauc, incl. the bib-header-documented alias narasimhan2013pauc consolidated onto that ONE record -- the single deduplicated duplicate), ROC operating points (fawcett2006roc), ensemble/gating (jacobs1991adaptive, hinton2015distilling, shazeer2017outrageously), temporal/event false-alarm anchors (abbate2011false_alarms, kangas2014fall_sensor -- wearable-domain, mapped only indirect/background), walking detection (wang2016gait, xu2022attention, lin2022wifi -- mapped indirect), gait/fall-risk data acquisition (verghese2009quantitative, hausdorff2001gait, piau2019when, vanschooten2016daily, chan2023prediction, beattie2020cart). Every candidate-direction mapping carries an explicit relationship strength (direct/indirect/background/not_established). Honesty mechanics: 1 conflicting_local record (miyato2018vat -- references.bib title 'Virtual Adversarial Training: A Regularization Method...' vs the D9 framing table's 'Distributional Smoothing with Virtual Adversarial Training'; recorded under metadata_conflicts, NOT silently resolved); 2 citation-key label quirks noted in notes (yang2022sensefi year field 2023, song2018mat year field 2017); paper_contribution_summary is strictly what the LOCAL framing says the paper reports while relevance_to_current_results is prefixed 'OUR INTERPRETATION:' with interpretation_status local_interpretation; paper_limitations_summary left null wherever not locally documented (never invented); per-paper claim_boundaries forbid image-domain->CSI transfer claims, paper-benchmark-as-our-result claims, clinical/deployment claims, and attributing internal H15/D8/AFAC/BASAT labels to external papers. 5 literature_gaps recorded (gap_ut_har_source_publication, gap_probability_calibration_low_far, gap_wifi_csi_temporal_false_alarm_reduction, gap_walking_pattern_labeled_csi_dataset, gap_longitudinal_csi_fall_risk_cohort) instead of inventing papers. WiCAM (wicam2022) and WiCAM2.0 (xu2024wicam) deliberately NOT merged. Validator scripts/automation/validate_paper_registry.py (read-only, no network imports, no PDF requirement, deterministic output, defaults to the real registry+goals paths): enforces the 25 specified checks incl. unique paper_id, single-owner citation keys, DOI/normalized-title duplicate detection, status-dependent required fields, no premature externally_verified/doi_verified, no internal-label papers, relationship-strength requirement, goal-registry task-tag validation, no sensefi_ut_har + future-fall-risk co-occurrence (mirrors datasets.yaml unsupported_goals), 900-char text ceiling (no long verbatim extracts), assertive-clinical-claim rejection (negated boundary phrasing allowed), D1-D14 defense-line label validation, and absolute-path rejection. Real-registry validation: PASS, zero errors (papers=47 citation_keys=48 unresolved_or_conflicting=1 gaps=5). Tests scripts/automation/test_paper_registry.py: P1-P25 + 3 defensive extras = 28/28 ALL PASS (synthetic fixtures for all failure cases; real registry only read). Thesis/Overleaf repository, references.bib, chapters, appendices: READ-ONLY, not modified (git status in that repository untouched by this work). automation/registry/* (goals/datasets/reference_evidence/experiment_identity/README), artifact_manifest.csv, result ledgers, results/, checkpoints/, update_dashboard.py, dashboard_research_summary.py, result_explorer.py and their tests: NOT modified. No experiment, training, validation, model-evaluation, export, or threshold-selection command ran; no command contained --split. No experiment recommendation was made; no dashboard literature section was added (D3 rendering untouched).
